# Android delivery

`PULSE-debug.apk` is the verified installable debug build, copied from the actual Gradle output after tests and lint. It requires Android 9 / API 28 or newer. Health Connect availability depends on the device. PULSE also supports Garmin Personal API for personal use.

This APK is signed for development. Verify its integrity with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. The generated APK is available in this delivery workspace and excluded from Git.
